page.layout: One page of text, single column of dictionary entries; running head at top with page number 180 at top right. No margin notes. Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words embedded in the lines.

main_text.p: חמל ܚܡܠ Syr. Collegit, congregavit, coegit, Matth.6.26. & Lucæ 12.17.
חמם Ch. Incalescere, Calidum esse vel fieri: Syr. Verrere, Everrere, Scopis mundare, purgare, Idè quod Ch. חמם, Part. ܚܡܝܢܐ Et verrit, Luc.15. 8. Pehil ܚܡܐ Scopis mundatum, Matth.12.44.
חומא, חומתא Ch. ܚܡܬܐ Syr. Calor, Æstus. Affine est Græc. κᾶυμα.
חמים Ch. Calidus. 1.Sam. 21.7. Vide præterea in חמת & יחם.
חמם Chald. Rapere, abripere, auferre. Ex Ithpahel אתחמסי Abrepta est.Gen.7.21.in Jon. Heb. וינוע Et expiravit. Pravum videtur pro אתחמיים.
חומסין Ch.Raptores. Genef.6.11.in Targ.Hierof.ex forma Hebraea,pro חַמְסִין,vel חמוסין.
ܚܡܫ Syr. Consistere, persistere, durare, perdurare, perseverare, ferre, sustinere, tenere, retinere.
חמע Ch.& Syr. Fermentari. Ab Hebraeo חמץ, per cōmutationem litterarum ץ & ע. Aphel אחמע Fermentare.
main_text.l: מחמע, מחמעא Ch.Idem. Ibid.v.20.in Onk.& Jon.
main_text.p: חמין Pahel Ch. Cōtristare, tristitiam afferre. Aphel אחמין Cōturbare, pudefacere, pudore suffundere, Ignominiâ afficere, Prov.25.8. & 28.7.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek forms are transcribed as best read; the Syriac and some vocalised Hebrew words in the scan are blurred and may be imperfect. The signature-like mark at the foot right is a Syriac-style flourish, not a catchword, and is not transcribed as text.
